node.label: Art, Culture & Heritage
node.summary: Festivals, heritage and archaeology, films, books and the arts.

facts.text: Namit Malhotra's ***Ramayana***, billed as the most expensive Indian film, stars **Ranbir Kapoor** as Rama and **Yash** as Ravana and releases on **5 Nov**.
facts.plain: Namit Malhotra's Ramayana, billed as the most expensive Indian film, stars Ranbir Kapoor as Rama and Yash as Ravana and releases on 5 Nov.

facts.text: Kumbh Mela is held at four places — **Haridwar** (Ganga), **Prayagraj** (Sangam), **Nashik** (Godavari) and **Ujjain** (Shipra). UNESCO listed it as **Intangible Cultural Heritage** in **2017**.

facts.text: **Haridwar Kumbh 2027** runs **14 Jan-20 Apr 2027**; Amrit Snan dates include **6 Mar (Mahashivratri)**, **8 Mar** and **14 Apr (Mesh Sankranti, main Amrit Snan)**. Nearest airport: **Jolly Grant (Dehradun)**. Uttarakhand CM: **Pushkar Singh Dhami**.

facts.text: Book ***The Relentless Sprinter*** (Shanker Basu, ex-Indian cricket team strength coach) traces sprinter **Nithin's** national **200m record of 20.66 seconds**.
facts.plain: Book The Relentless Sprinter (Shanker Basu, ex-Indian cricket team strength coach) traces sprinter Nithin's national 200m record of 20.66 seconds.

facts.text: Chola bronzes were cast by the **lost-wax (cire perdue)** method; the Ananda Tandava Nataraja is associated with **Chidambaram**.
facts.plain: Chola bronzes were cast by the lost-wax (cire perdue) method; the Ananda Tandava Nataraja is associated with Chidambaram.

facts.text: Tamil Nadu archaeologists unearthed **Chola-era** bronze idols of **Nataraja** (Ananda Tandava, four arms, 110 cm) and **Goddess Sivagami** (Tribhanga posture) in **Nagapattinam**, dated to the **12th century AD**.

facts.text: **IIT Jodhpur** documented the astronomy of tribes (Bhil, Meena, Banjara, Gond, Kolam, Korku) and built a **'Nakshatra Vatika'** at Nandiya Kalan village matching trees (jamun, peepal, khejri, banyan) to constellations; the study went to the Education Ministry's **Indian Knowledge Systems (IKS) Division**.

facts.text: **Somnath** temple (Prabhas Patan, **Gir Somnath** district, Gujarat) is regarded as the first of the **12 Jyotirlingas**; it was rebuilt after Independence on Sardar Patel's initiative and inaugurated in **1951**.

facts.text: Tamil film ***Dorothy*** (dir. **Karthik Subbaraj**, released 25 Sept) uses the rooster motif of **Bahuchara Mata**, a goddess linked with transgender communities whose mount is a **rooster**.
